ethnicity.legal_basis: ECOA (15 USC §1691); Reg B (12 CFR §1002); HMDA (Reg C)
ethnicity.notes: Cannot be used as a decision factor. Collection required for mortgage applications under HMDA / Reg B §1002.13.

religion.notes: ECOA prohibits using religion as a decision factor; not on the HMDA monitoring list.

marital_status.notes: Cannot be used to discriminate; may be collected only for joint-application or community-property states.

age.notes: Age may be used in an empirically derived, statistically sound credit scoring system but not as a categorical denial reason.

criminal_record.notes: Generally lawful; subject to FCRA reporting limits and increasing state-level scrutiny.

genetic.legal_basis: GINA Title I (covers health insurance, not lending); state laws vary

postcode.notes: Redlining risk. Pulse should flag postcode as a proxy for race.
